title: Slushie Bar Xtra Twin Cherry Breeze 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Slushie Bar Xtra Twin Cherry Breeze combines the sweet, juicy taste of ripe Cherries with a subtle sour twist and a refreshing Menthol breeze. This flavour offers a perfectly balanced cherry vape, with the sweetness of the fruit enhanced by a cool, breezy finish for an invigorating and satisfying experience. Ideal for vapers who enjoy fruit and menthol blends, Twin Cherry Breeze delivers a clean and refreshing vape that can be enjoyed all day long. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Slushie Bar Xtra Nic Salts are designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) vape kits and pod systems. Each e-liquid in the collection provides smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine relief, making them ideal for those seeking a satisfying alternative to traditional tobacco. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these e-liquids are perfect for all-day vaping with a flavour-packed experience waiting in every puff.
